title: Walkable To Broadway | Karaoke, Patio & Photo Fun
description:
Welcome to your Nashville getaway! This cozy condo is the perfect home base for exploring Music City, whether you're here for a weekend with friends, a couples' trip, or a fun Nashville adventure. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, Smart TV and Roku, a private patio with outdoor seating and a gas BBQ, plus fun extras like a karaoke machine, selfie ring light, and cowboy hat photo props. After a day of exploring Nashville, come home, fire up the grill, play some board games, and make yourself comfor

The space
➝ Sleeps up to 6 guests
➝ 2 sleeping areas with a King Bed and Queen Bed
➝ Pull-out sofa for additional sleeping
➝ 1 full bathroom with shower
➝ Open-concept living/sleeping area
➝ Smart TV + Roku
➝ Karaoke machine
➝ Full-length mirror, selfie ring light & cowboy hat photo props
➝ Board games for indoor entertainment
➝ Fully equipped kitchen with stove, oven, microwave & refrigerator
➝ Coffee maker, Keurig, kettle, blender & Crockpot
➝ Dishwasher, toaster & cooking basics
➝ Coffee, creamer, sugar & seasonings provided
➝ Private patio with outdoor furniture
➝ Gas BBQ grill
➝ Fully fenced outdoor area
➝ Complimentary bathroom toiletries, towels & hair dryer
➝ Central AC & heating
➝ High-speed Wi-Fi
➝ Smart Lock self check-in
➝ Free laundry detergent; shared washer & dryer available in the clubhouse

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire property, including the living area, kitchen, bedrooms, bathroom, and outdoor patio. Self check-in is available using the Smart Lock at the front door.

Sleeping Arrangements

➝ Bedroom 1 / Open Living Area: King Bed + Pull-Out Sofa
➝ Bedroom 2: Queen Bed
➝ Maximum occupancy: 6 guests

Please note: Bedroom 1 and the living area are part of one large open-concept space and are not separated by a door. The pull-out sofa is located in this shared space.

Other things to note
There is one full bathroom in the property.
There is no private pool or hot tub.
Pets are not allowed.

A front-door security camera/doorbell camera is present for exterior security. There is no backyard/pool-area camera.

For laundry, there is no washer or dryer inside the unit, but guests can use the washer and dryer in the clubhouse. Laundry detergent is provided.

Parking includes one gated parking space, plus one regular parking-lot space when available. Additional street parking is available around the condo building.

We look forward to hosting you in Nashville, where you can enjoy the best of Music City while having a comfortable place to relax, unwind, and make unforgettable memories!
